answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a stake-and-slash identity bond verified by a rotating audit quorum. Each new agent locks capital and earns a violet seal; chosen peers then test whether it is truly independent. A fake persona is only a fable, and once auditors link many to one operator, all their bonds are slashed together. The rule is as hard as basalt: standing comes from capital at risk, not fresh keys. To buy a thousand votes an attacker must lock a thousand bonds, and any detected correlation turns the whole hoard into a loss.
